highlights: Early release on school Mondays, including August 10 and November 30

paragraphs: Students begin the 2026–27 school year on Monday, August 10, and the first day has early dismissal. The district releases students early on every Monday when classes are held, including November 30, when students return from Fall Break. Dismissal times vary by school, so check your campus bell schedule before arranging pickup. On the last day, Friday, May 28, students leave 2.5 hours earlier than usual under a separate rule.

Two local events bring days off from school: the Florida State Fair in Tampa on Friday, February 12, and the Strawberry Festival in Plant City on Monday, March 8. The district moved the Strawberry Festival day from March 1 to March 8; March 1 remains a school Monday with early release. Presidents Day on February 15 follows the State Fair day, giving students four consecutive days off from February 12 through February 15.

Fall Break is November 23–27, although November 23–25 may be used for hurricane make-up. October 12, November 11 and January 4 are also tentative make-up dates. Winter Break runs December 21 through January 1, with students scheduled to return January 5. Spring Break is March 22–26, followed by a separate non-student day on March 29. Students return Tuesday, March 30. Check district announcements before relying on a tentative make-up date as a day off.

about.processing: Expand the explicit every-Monday early-release rule over instructional Mondays only. First day August 10 and return November 30 each remain one canonical occurrence with both meanings. Do not expand the rule over any published full non-student day, including conditional reserves. Keep May 28 as one last-day, early-release, fourth-grading-end and second-semester-end occurrence. The last-day 2.5-hour reduction does not supply Monday clock times. Preserve Fall Break November 23-27, Winter Break December 21-January 1 and Spring Break March 22-26 exactly; represent November 23/24/25 as individual reserves and November 26-27 as the fixed Fall Break segment without overlapping events. October 12, November 11 and January 4 are the other conditional reserves. Their no-class status describes the published baseline; no absolute attendance flag is assigned. January 4 and March 29 are separate non-student days, not extensions of the named breaks. All three return dates are explicitly printed. Original approval June 17, 2025 is separate from the printed March 24, 2026 revision; Board approval of that revision is not independently established. March 1 is superseded only as a holiday and remains a shortened instructional Monday. Annual attendance 180 is derived from 210 weekdays minus 24 fixed and six conditional planned no-school weekdays. The fixed longest winter stretch excludes the conditional January 4 reserve; a 17-day planned stretch requires that reserve to remain unused. Riverview bell row applies only from September 10; its page explicitly retires the older schedule. Bell-table a.m./p.m. follows the published period sequence. No districtwide dismissal clock is inferred from either Riverview or Benito. Employee-only entries, report-card, exam, graduation and summer dates are not invented.

faqs.question: When does school start in Hillsborough County in 2026?
faqs.answer: The first day of school is Monday, August 10, 2026. It is also an early-release day, so students attend classes but leave earlier than on a regular school day. Check your school's dismissal time before arranging pickup.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in Hillsborough County in 2027?
faqs.answer: Friday, May 28, 2027 is the last day of school. Students are dismissed 2.5 hours earlier than their regular dismissal time. The fourth grading period and second semester also end that day.

faqs.question: Do Hillsborough schools dismiss early every Monday in 2026–27?
faqs.answer: Yes, on Mondays when students have classes. The published calendar includes 31 instructional Mondays with early release, including the first day on August 10 and the return from Fall Break on November 30. Mondays designated as non-student days are excluded from that count.

faqs.question: What time is early release on Mondays in Hillsborough County?
faqs.answer: There is no single districtwide Monday dismissal time. For example, Riverview High's bell schedule effective September 10, 2026 lists 2:35 p.m. on instructional Mondays. That time applies only to Riverview High. Check your child's school for its own early-release dismissal time.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break in Hillsborough County in 2026?
faqs.answer: The district calls it Fall Break, scheduled for November 23–27, 2026. Students are scheduled to return Monday, November 30, with early dismissal. November 23–25 are tentative hurricane make-up dates, so those first three days of the break could become school days.

faqs.question: When is winter break, and when do students return in January 2027?
faqs.answer: Winter Break runs from December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027. Monday, January 4 is a separate non-student day and tentative hurricane make-up date. The published return date is Tuesday, January 5, unless January 4 is used for make-up classes.

faqs.question: When is spring break in Hillsborough County in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring Break is March 22–26, 2027. Students also have Monday, March 29 off as a separate non-student day and return Tuesday, March 30. Including the surrounding weekends, the scheduled stretch without classes runs March 20–29.

faqs.question: Do Hillsborough students have school on Good Friday, March 26, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. March 26 falls within the district's Spring Break, which runs March 22–26. The school calendar lists the break rather than a separate Good Friday holiday. Monday, March 29 is another non-student day, and students are scheduled to return Tuesday, March 30.

faqs.question: Which dates could be used as hurricane make-up days in 2026–27?
faqs.answer: The district lists six tentative dates: October 12, November 11 and November 23–25, 2026, plus January 4, 2027. These are non-student dates under the published schedule but may be used for classes if the district needs to make up closures. Check district announcements for any changes.

faqs.question: When is the Strawberry Festival school holiday in 2027?
faqs.answer: Monday, March 8, 2027 is the Strawberry Festival non-student day. The district moved it from March 1 to March 8 in its updated calendar. March 1 remains a school day with Monday early release. The Strawberry Festival takes place in Plant City.

faqs.question: Do students get a day off for the Florida State Fair?
faqs.answer: Yes. Friday, February 12, 2027 is a non-student day for the Florida State Fair. Presidents Day on Monday, February 15 is also a day off, giving students a four-day weekend from February 12 through February 15. Classes resume Tuesday, February 16.

faqs.question: Are Hillsborough schools closed on Presidents Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, February 15, 2027 is a non-student day for Presidents Day. The Florida State Fair non-student day falls on Friday, February 12, giving students four consecutive days without classes.

faqs.question: Do Hillsborough County schools have classes on Labor Day 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, September 7, 2026 is a non-student holiday for Labor Day. Students are scheduled to return Tuesday, September 8.

faqs.question: Are Hillsborough schools closed for Martin Luther King Jr. Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, January 18, 2027 is a non-student holiday for Martin Luther King Jr. Day. Classes resume Tuesday, January 19.

faqs.question: Is Veterans Day a no-school day in 2026?
faqs.answer: Wednesday, November 11, 2026 is listed as a non-student day for Veterans Day. However, it is also a tentative hurricane make-up date, so the district may schedule classes that day if needed.

faqs.question: Did Hillsborough students have school on Columbus Day, October 12, 2026?
faqs.answer: The published 2026–27 calendar listed October 12 as a non-student day and a tentative hurricane make-up date. The district did not label it a Columbus Day holiday. The published calendar alone does not confirm whether classes were ultimately held that day; check dated district or school notices for the actual attendance status.

faqs.question: Do students have school on April 16, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Friday, April 16 is a non-student day. The district does not give it a specific holiday name. Students have a three-day weekend and are scheduled back Monday, April 19, which is an early-release day.

faqs.question: When do the grading periods and semesters end in 2026–27?
faqs.answer: The four grading periods end October 9 and December 18, 2026, followed by March 12 and May 28, 2027. The first semester ends December 18 and the second ends May 28. These dates are grading-period boundaries, not confirmed report-card distribution dates.

faqs.question: How many school days are planned in 2026–27?
faqs.answer: The published dates yield 180 planned student attendance days, including early-release days. This is calculated from the calendar, not an annual total printed in the district's PDF. The calculation assumes the six tentative hurricane make-up dates remain unused; later closures or make-up decisions may change the schedule.

faqs.question: Where can I find the official 2026–27 Hillsborough school calendar PDF?
faqs.answer: Use the official 2026–2027 Student Academic Calendar PDF linked on this page or the district's Student Academic Calendar document page. This page also offers a downloadable calendar file that can be imported into Google Calendar or Apple Calendar. A one-time import does not automatically update when district dates change.

faqs.question: Does this calendar apply to charter schools and separate programs?
faqs.answer: This page follows the regular Hillsborough County Public Schools Student Academic Calendar. Charter schools and separate programs may have different schedules. Confirm the dates and dismissal times directly with your child's school.

about.dataSource: The current 2027-2028 Student Academic Calendar, with School Board approval printed as July 14, 2026. Extracted text and the rendered page were inspected; the live PDF matches the local file by SHA-256. The district’s July 14 approval article mirrored on Benito’s site independently repeats the dates and the unresolved early-release schedule.
about.processing: Do not apply the previous year’s every-Monday release rule. August 16 is explicitly a regular full student day; annual early-release arrangements are not finalized. Only the last-day 2.5-hour reduction is entered as a shortened date. One May 26 occurrence also carries fourth-grading-end and second-semester-end meanings. First/last and the November 29, January 4 and March 21 return dates are explicitly printed. Preserve named Fall Break November 22-26, Winter Break December 20-31 and Spring Break March 13-17. Partition Fall Break into November 22/23/24 individual conditional reserves and a fixed November 25-26 segment. November 11 and January 3 are the other two conditional reserves. Each retains its published no-class baseline and possible activation without an absolute attendance flag. January 3 and March 20 are separate non-student days outside the named breaks. No October 12 non-student date, March 29 closure, April 16 closure or previous-year bell times are carried forward. April 14 is not named Good Friday in the source. Annual 180 is derived from 209 weekdays less 24 fixed and five currently unused conditional no-class weekdays. The longest fixed winter span ends January 2; the 17-day planned span through January 3 requires the reserve to remain unused. Approval date comes from the document, not its filename. No revision date or PDF publication date is independently established; the separately dated approval notice remains its own source. No employee-only, report-card, graduation, exam or summer dates are invented.
about.updates: Checked the current calendar listing, matching PDF, approval article and accessible district notices on October 19, 2026. No later revision finalizing the 2027-2028 early-release schedule or activating a reserve was verified in the reviewed material. The 2026-2027 campus bell changes do not establish next year’s hours.
about.disclaimer: Check district announcements for the final early-release schedule and any hurricane make-up decisions. Confirm campus dismissal times directly with your school.

faqs.question: When does school start in Hillsborough County in 2027?
faqs.answer: The first day of school is Tuesday, August 10, 2027. The district calendar does not identify the first day as an early-release day. Check your school's first-day arrival and dismissal instructions.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in Hillsborough County in 2028?
faqs.answer: Friday, May 26, 2028 is the last day of school. Students are dismissed 2.5 hours earlier than their regular school dismissal time. The fourth grading period and second semester also end that day.

faqs.question: Will Hillsborough schools have early release every Monday in 2027–28?
faqs.answer: The district has not finalized the annual early-release schedule in its approved 2027–28 calendar. Do not assume the previous year's Monday early-release rule will continue. The calendar specifically says August 16 is a regular school day with no early release. The last-day early release on May 26 is separately confirmed.

faqs.question: Is Monday, August 16, 2027 an early-release day?
faqs.answer: No. The approved calendar specifically identifies Monday, August 16, 2027 as a regular student day with no early release. Other dates will depend on the district's finalized early-release schedule.

faqs.question: What time do Hillsborough schools start and dismiss students in 2027–28?
faqs.answer: The district's annual academic calendar does not provide school-by-school bell times, and its early-release schedule has not yet been finalized. Check your child's school for its 2027–28 arrival, dismissal and early-release times. Do not use a previous year's bell schedule as confirmation.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break in Hillsborough County in 2027?
faqs.answer: Fall Break is November 22–26, 2027, with students scheduled to return Monday, November 29. November 22–24 are tentative hurricane make-up dates and could become school days. November 25–26 are not listed as make-up reserves.

faqs.question: When is winter break, and when does school resume in January 2028?
faqs.answer: Winter Break runs from December 20 through December 31, 2027. Monday, January 3, 2028 is a separate non-student day and tentative hurricane make-up date. Students are scheduled to return Tuesday, January 4, unless the district uses January 3 for make-up classes.

faqs.question: When is spring break in Hillsborough County in 2028?
faqs.answer: Spring Break is March 13–17, 2028. Monday, March 20 is also a non-student day, listed separately from the break. Students return Tuesday, March 21. Including both weekends and the extra Monday, the scheduled stretch without classes runs March 11–20.

faqs.question: Which days are set aside for hurricane make-up in 2027–28?
faqs.answer: The five tentative dates are November 11 and November 22–24, 2027, plus January 3, 2028. These dates are scheduled without regular student classes but may be used if the district needs to make up missed instruction. Check current announcements before relying on them as days off.

faqs.question: Do Hillsborough students have school during the Florida State Fair in 2028?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes on Friday, February 18, 2028, the district's Florida State Fair non-student day. Presidents Day on Monday, February 21 is also a day off, creating a four-day weekend. Students are scheduled back Tuesday, February 22.

faqs.question: Are Hillsborough schools closed on Presidents Day in 2028?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, February 21, 2028 is a non-student day for Presidents Day. It follows the Florida State Fair non-student day on Friday, February 18, creating a four-day weekend. Students are scheduled back Tuesday, February 22.

faqs.question: When is the Strawberry Festival no-school day in 2028?
faqs.answer: Monday, March 6, 2028 is the Strawberry Festival non-student day. The festival is a local event in Plant City. This day off is separate from Spring Break, which starts the following Monday, March 13.

faqs.question: Do Hillsborough County schools have classes on Labor Day 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, September 6, 2027 is a non-student holiday for Labor Day. Students are scheduled to return Tuesday, September 7.

faqs.question: Are Hillsborough schools closed for Martin Luther King Jr. Day in 2028?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, January 17, 2028 is a non-student holiday for Martin Luther King Jr. Day. Classes resume Tuesday, January 18.

faqs.question: Is Veterans Day 2027 a school day in Hillsborough County?
faqs.answer: Thursday, November 11, 2027 is scheduled as a non-student day for Veterans Day. However, it is also a tentative hurricane make-up date and could become a student attendance day if the district needs to make up missed classes.

faqs.question: Do Hillsborough students have school on Columbus Day, October 11, 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes, under the published 2027–28 district calendar. October 11 falls on Columbus Day, but the district does not list it as a non-student day. Students are scheduled to attend classes unless a later district announcement changes the schedule.

faqs.question: Are Hillsborough schools closed on Good Friday, April 14, 2028?
faqs.answer: Yes. Friday, April 14, 2028 is a non-student day and also falls on Good Friday. The district's academic calendar labels it only as Non-Student Day, without naming a specific holiday. Students are scheduled to return Monday, April 17.

faqs.question: When do Hillsborough grading periods and semesters end in 2027–28?
faqs.answer: The four grading periods end October 8 and December 17, 2027, followed by March 10 and May 26, 2028. The first semester ends December 17 and the second ends May 26. Report-card distribution dates are not provided in this academic calendar.

faqs.question: How many school days are planned in 2027–28?
faqs.answer: The approved calendar dates yield 180 planned student attendance days. This is calculated from 209 weekdays between August 10 and May 26, minus 24 fixed non-student weekdays and five tentative hurricane make-up dates currently scheduled without classes. The district PDF does not publish 180 as an annual total, and later operational changes may affect the schedule.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official 2027–28 Hillsborough school calendar PDF?
faqs.answer: Use the official 2027–2028 Student Academic Calendar PDF linked on this page or the district's Student Academic Calendar document page. The PDF shows School Board approval on July 14, 2026. A calendar file is also available on this page for importing dates into Google Calendar or Apple Calendar; a one-time import will not automatically receive updates.

faqs.question: Does the 2027–28 calendar cover charter schools and other programs?
faqs.answer: This page covers the regular Hillsborough County Public Schools Student Academic Calendar. Charter schools and separate programs may follow different schedules. Confirm important dates and school-day hours directly with the school your child attends.
